components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary {font: 13px var(--font-ui); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); padding: 13px 18px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-primary:hover {background: var(--accent-hover);} .ds-primary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-primary:disabled {opacity: .45; cursor: default;}

components.name: Quiet action
components.css: .ds-quiet {font: 13px var(--font-ui); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 9px 12px;} .ds-quiet:hover {background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--text);} .ds-quiet:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}

components.name: Feedback field
components.html: <textarea class="ds-feedback" aria-label="Feedback" placeholder="What would you change?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-feedback {font: 12px var(--font-ui); line-height: 1.85; background: var(--ground); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 110px; resize: vertical; caret-color: var(--accent);} .ds-feedback::placeholder {color: var(--muted);} .ds-feedback:focus {border-color: var(--accent);} .ds-feedback:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.css: .ds-nav {display:flex; gap:6px;} .ds-nav button {font: 13px var(--font-ui); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; background: transparent; color:var(--muted); padding:8px 10px;} .ds-nav button[aria-current] {background:var(--surface-hover); color:var(--text);} .ds-nav button:hover {background:var(--surface-hover);} .ds-nav button:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px;}

components.name: Review surface
components.css: .ds-stage {background:var(--card); color:var(--soft); border-radius:var(--card-radius); padding:16px 18px; min-height:160px;} .ds-stage span {font:10px var(--font-ui); background:var(--ground); padding:4px 6px; border-radius:4px;}

narrative.overview: Scene Loom’s visual system applied to Mesh Foundry’s artwork-led asset review worktable. Preserve exact revision identity and deliberate owner decisions.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces and pale blue actions
dos: Follow the shared visual tokens and fonts.
Keep technical validation separate from owner acceptance.
donts: Do not add dashboard metrics or ornamental motion.
Do not copy storyboard behavior into asset review.
